card.joinThroughTeam: You take part in an event through a team.
card.disabled: Registration was disabled by an administrator: actions are unavailable.
card.selfReport: The system does not check the external site: the registration mark is your own report.
card.noRegistration: Registration is not required for this event
card.markedHint: You will get no more reminders about this event

detail.confirmPublishHint: The event will appear in the catalog and its participants will receive the primary notifications held back until now. Publishing cannot be undone.
detail.confirmArchiveTitle: Move the event to the archive?
detail.confirmArchiveHint: The event will disappear from the catalog and the schedule, and its pending notifications will be cancelled. An archived event cannot be restored.

place.derivedHint: The format is derived from the stages: at least one of them is held in person.

tracks.emptyHint: Split the prize pool across directions: every track carries its own places and amounts.
tracks.hackathonOnly: Only a hackathon can carry tracks.
tracks.noPool: Set a prize pool and a currency on the General tab first — there is nothing to distribute yet.
tracks.budgetMeter: Share of the prize pool distributed
tracks.formPrizesEmpty: No places added: a track may exist without prizes.
tracks.overBudget: Over the prize pool by {{over}}. Lower the amounts or raise the event pool.
tracks.overBudgetServer: The prizes of every track together do not fit the event prize pool. Lower the amounts or raise the pool on the General tab.
tracks.deleteFailed: The track could not be deleted
tracks.reorderFailed: The tracks could not be reordered
tracks.confirmDeleteHint: The track “{{name}}” and its prize places will be deleted. Teams that chose it stay entered, with no track.

finance.title: Finance
finance.discrepancyHint: The discrepancy is the pool minus what tracks and cases hand out. It blocks nothing: a pool may exceed the prizes as a reserve, or fall short while a sponsor is still expected.
finance.noPool: The event declares no prize pool, so there is nothing to reconcile against.
finance.exportFailed: The reconciliation could not be exported

cases.title: Cases
cases.prizeWhole: A prize is a whole number without cents
cases.formPrizeHint: A whole number in the event currency. Leave it empty when there is no prize.
cases.confirmDeleteHint: The case “{{name}}” and its prize leave the reconciliation. This cannot be undone.
